subject: AcmeCorp — subprocessor list & compliance follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCorp — subprocessor list & compliance follow-up

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so the security team has what they need to start a review: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned internal controls are in place and an external audit is scheduled for Q4. Can you confirm whether you currently have a SOC 2 Type II report or a readiness assessment?
- HIPAA/GDPR: you indicated some workloads handle PHI and EU customer data; can you confirm if Acme has an existing BAA and Data Processing Addendum (DPA) in place?
- Subprocessor list: please send the canonical list of subprocessors (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, support access). If possible, include what data each subprocessor processes and whether they have access to plaintext customer data.

If you can share the subprocessor CSV and the vendor questionnaire we can route to our security team — Monica will lead the review. Proposed next steps:
1) You send the subprocessor list + questionnaire (we can accept CSV/PDF).
2) Monica runs a quick triage and flags anything that needs legal/engineering escalation.
3) If needed, schedule a short sync (30 min) with Michael or your security lead next week.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0187

[Attachment: subprocessor_request_template.csv (text/csv) — blank template we discussed]

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Attaching the files you requested. Quick answers inline below.

- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in May 2026 (report available).
- HIPAA / PHI: We are HIPAA-aligned and currently execute BAAs with partners that process PHI; we�re happy to get a BAA in place with Redwood if needed.
- Data residency / GDPR: We have a DPA and standard SCCs for EU customers.

Attachments: 
- Acme_Subprocessors_20270914.csv (contains vendor name, service category, region, whether they process customer data, access type)
- Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (partially completed vendor questionnaire; I highlighted items we think are relevant)

A couple of notes from the CSV: our primary cloud provider is AWS (us-west-2) and we use Google Workspace for productivity; analytics providers have only aggregated telemetry (no customer PII). Support engineers have access to logs via a ticket tool (obfuscated tokens except where customers provide samples). If you�d like, Michael can join a short call to walk Monica through the attachments.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of IT Security | Acme Corp
samantha.green@acmecorp.com
[Attachment: Acme_Subprocessors_20270914.csv (text/csv)]

Hi Samantha / Michael — got the files, thanks for the fast turnaround and for including the highlights. Monica will start triage today. Two quick clarifying questions before Monica does a deeper pass: 

1) In the CSV some entries list "support tools" as having access to logs. Can you confirm whether those logs include any plaintext customer content (examples you gave were obfuscated tokens, which is fine) or if there are exceptions?
2) For third-party analytics you indicated aggregated telemetry only — can you confirm that no PII or identifiers (email/customer ids) are sent to those vendors?

If it's easier, we're happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough with Michael to have him point to specific lines in the CSV. Monica — once you triage, can you flag any items that need legal or engineering follow-up (especially BAA negotiation points)? Ben — can you add this to the HubSpot deal and track the security review status? HubSpot link below.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
